h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Etawah

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Etawah

items.pText: Etawah lies on the plains of western Uttar Pradesh, with the Yamuna flowing past the town and the Chambal ravines close by. Summers here bring hot, dry winds, and winters are cold and often foggy. Outdoor equipment has to handle both extremes, year after year. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for schools, parks and housing colonies at our factory in Vasai, about 1,030 km away, and sends it to Etawah by road.

Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are made for outdoor use through all of these seasons, which is why we build our frames and slides from them. Many Etawah enquiries come from schools with nursery and primary sections, so we often plan for the youngest children first. Share the age groups and the size of your site, and we will propose a layout with the safe play area marked around every piece.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing equipment for nursery and primary children

c: Children aged 2 to 5 need low heights, wide steps and handholds within reach. Look at 3 ft slides, spring riders, a toddler swing with a cradle seat and small crawl tunnels. Children from 6 to 10 can move on to 5 ft slides, climbers and see-saws. Keep the two groups in separate zones, each with its own safe play area, so the little ones are not knocked over by older children in a hurry.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,030 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What playground equipment suits children under five?
items.a: Low slides, spring riders, toddler swings and crawl tunnels, which keep heights small and movements simple. We mark a separate safe play area for this group on the layout drawing.

items.q: Does the equipment cope with Etawah's hot summers and cold winters?
items.a: Yes. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for outdoor use in every season, with a 3-year warranty on pipes and moulded parts against manufacturing defects.

items.q: How do I get a quote for a school in Etawah?
items.a: Call +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com with your site size, photos and age groups. We will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing.
